format: the description requires every criterion to be validated for three user types (guest, customer, administrator), and AC-6 also for three data sets (Hammer, Hand Saw, Wrench)

defects.description: a customer reading another customer's invoice gets 404, not the required 403 (administrator 200 and guest 401 are as required)

accounts: existing accounts (public demo credentials): customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com, customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com (the 'another customer' of AC-5), admin@practicesoftwaretesting.com (role admin); the customers get the role customer; the password is the one the demo publishes for its sample accounts, kept in .env
traps: the framework's accounts are one pool of interchangeable users: a test asking for 'a customer' may be handed the administrator
AC-5 needs a second customer who owns an invoice
the defect shows only for the customer variant of AC-5
